MoonBear is a creative powerhouse built for filmmakers, editors, and content creators. We provide premium creative assets for filmmakers—including cinematic LUTs, video editing templates, title packs, sound design, and more—to help you bring your stories to life.

items.title: What types of products does MoonBear sell?

children.html: MoonBear offers a full library of filmmaking resources, including:LUTs & color grading packs for cinematic looksTitle templates & graphics for Final Cut Pro, Premiere, and DaVinci ResolveTransitions & effects to elevate your editsSound packs & audio design tools for immersive storytellingFilmmaker bundles with everything you need to build a professional editing toolkit.

MoonBear is designed for filmmakers, editors, YouTubers, and content creators who want high-quality, easy-to-use tools. Whether you’re working on music videos, commercials, indie films, or social content, MoonBear gives you assets that save time and elevate production value.

Our products have been used by professionals at Nsascar, Adidas, L'Officiel, Lashify, Bulgari & more.

Our assets are built with professional workflows in mind, tested in real productions, and offered at affordable prices. We focus on quality, usability, and innovation, ensuring your toolkit is both powerful, accessible and utilizing leading technology.

MoonBear was co-founded by Derek Yancey jr.in May of 2019 as a video production company. 2 years into business the team launched moonbear.shop as a resource for creative assets and software for creatives.
